Chief_Complaint.content: 3-day history of watery diarrhea approximately 5–6 times per day

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Has had watery diarrhea for 3 days at a frequency of approximately 5–6 times per day
Illness onset associated with two episodes of vomiting, which have now resolved
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Onset with vomiting x2; vomiting resolved

History_of_Present_Illness.content: Reports poor appetite with minimal solid food intake
Felt feverish initially but has no fever now
History_of_Present_Illness.source_text: Fever: felt warm initially; no fever now

History_of_Present_Illness.content: No recent takeaway or restaurant food consumption

Medications.content: Uses a blue inhaler as needed
Oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) from pharmacy recommended
Paracetamol as needed if feverish or feeling weak recommended

Family_History.content: Father died of bowel cancer approximately 10 years ago
Family_History.source_text: died of bowel cancer ~10 yrs ago

Social_and_Family_History.content: Has been off work for the past 3 days

Assessment.content: Acute gastroenteritis characterized by 3 days of watery non-bloody diarrhea 5–6 times per day, resolved initial emesis, no abdominal pain, transient fever at onset, weakness and feeling dehydrated, and reduced oral intake
Assessment.source_text: Acute gastroenteritis — 3 days watery non-bloody diarrhea 5–6/day; initial emesis resolved; no abd pain; transient fever at start; feels weak/dehydrated; reduced PO

Assessment.content: Dehydration risk due to ongoing diarrhea with low intake
Assessment.source_text: 2. Dehydration risk — ongoing diarrhea with low intake

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage liberal oral fluid intake for acute gastroenteritis
Use oral rehydration solution (Dioralyte) from pharmacy for acute gastroenteritis
Use paracetamol as needed if feverish or feeling weak
Remain off work for the next 1–2 days and return when diarrhea-free for 24–48 hours
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Off work next 1–2 days; return when diarrhea-free 24–48 hrs

Plan_of_Care.content: Oral rehydration and monitoring of symptoms for dehydration risk
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Oral rehydration as above; monitor symptoms

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow up next week if not improved
Follow_up_Information.source_text: F/U next week if not improved
